name: jkbalaji
description: JK Balaji — Real Estate, Jewellery public sites + Enterprise Admin (Jamavisa Enterprises)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n types,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/types" "npm run start:dev -w @jkbalaji/api" "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/real-estate-web"
scripts.dev:stack:admin: concurrently -k -n types,api,admin -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/types" "npm run start:dev -w @jkbalaji/api" "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/admin-panel"
scripts.dev:stack:jewellery: concurrently -k -n types,api,jew -c gray,blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/types" "npm run start:dev -w @jkbalaji/api" "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/jewellery-web"
scripts.dev:stack:re: concurrently -k -n types,api,re -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/types" "npm run start:dev -w @jkbalaji/api" "npm run dev -w @jkbalaji/real-estate-web"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:api && npm run build:re && npm run build:jew && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:erp: npm run build:types && npm run build:api && npm run build:admin
scripts.build:public: npm run build:types && npm run build:re && npm run build:jew
scripts.typecheck:erp: npm run typecheck -w @jkbalaji/types && npm run typecheck -w @jkbalaji/api && npm run typecheck -w @jkbalaji/admin-panel
scripts.check:erp: npm run typecheck:erp && npm run test:api
scripts.check:predeploy:admin: npm run check:erp && npm run build:erp
scripts.clean: echo "Remove dist/.next via rimraf when needed"
